As per the Chinese media , a  Dutch missile frigate HNLMS De Ruyter,  intruded into China's  territorial waters while promoting  so-called “freedom of navigation. "  
 
PLAN  issued  verbal warnings and  then carried out   electronic jamming, for violation of its   territorial sovereignty .

    PLAN warned that next time  the Chinese military  may fire not only  warning shots but also  resolutely defend national territorial sovereignty .

  China has  noted that extra-regional countries other than the US often lack a clear understanding of the red  lines of many sensitive areas and the countries concerned in the Western Pacific, making their behavior more aggressive and  more likely to trigger  armed clashes.

 HNLMS De Ruyter was  in Manila for a three-day goodwill visit.    Netherlands has "intensified efforts"  to strengthen maritime partnerships with countries in the Indo-Pacific with a five month deployment mission and promote  "Freedom of Navigation ".
It  participated  in various   maneuvering exercises with the Philippine Navy .

HNLMS De Ruyter will also join the 2026 Rim of the Pacific Exercise, which will bring together 31 nations, including the Philippines, in and around the Hawaiian Islands from June 24 to July 31.

Though the Dutch Navy  by no means should try to re- enact its " Colonial activities".
